PersonReport.title: PersonReport
PersonReport.description: A lost or found person community report stored in the ReuniteApp Firestore directory.

trackingCode.description: Public 5-digit tracking code in TRK-XXXXX format.

approxAge.description: Estimated age in years (0 if unknown).

documentId.description: Optional government ID, ration card, or hospital token reference.

marksAndClothing.description: Physical marks, scars, clothing, and identifying details.

languagesSpoken.description: Languages or words spoken by the person.

cityDistrict.description: City or district where the person was spotted.

exactSpot.description: Specific landmark, station platform, shelter, or street spot.

gpsAccuracy.description: Optional GPS accuracy radius in meters.

reporterPhone.description: Contact phone number of the reporter.

reporterName.description: Optional name or affiliation of the reporter.

photoUrl.description: Compressed portrait data URL or HTTPS image URL.

reportedAt.description: ISO timestamp string when the sighting was reported.

status.description: Current resolution status of the case.

notesCount.description: Count of sighting notes logged in the notes subcollection.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the document was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the document was last updated.

SightingNote.title: SightingNote
SightingNote.description: A follow-up sighting log or status note attached to a PersonReport.

text.description: Sighting update or coordination note text.

reporter.description: Name or affiliation of the note contributor.

timestamp.description: ISO timestamp string for the note.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the note was created.

/reports/{reportId}.description: Public community directory of lost and found person reports.

/reports/{reportId}/notes/{noteId}.description: Subcollection of community sighting notes and updates for each report.
